seo.title: Built-in CRM for customers, tickets and live requests | Steps AI
seo.description: Keep customer records, support tickets and live requests from every chat in one CRM, or send leads to HubSpot.

hero.title: Customer records, tickets and live requests in one place.
hero.body: Every conversation can create or update a customer record. Tickets and live requests sit next to them, so your team sees the whole picture before they reply.
hero.reassurance: Built into every agent. Fields you define. HubSpot if you already use it.

steps.title: How records build themselves.
steps.intro: Your agent collects details during the conversation, and the CRM keeps them organised.

items.title: The agent collects details
items.body: Skills ask for the details you choose, such as name, email, company or phone, during the conversation.

items.title: A record is created or updated
items.body: The customer record is saved with where the customer came from and which agent they spoke to.

items.title: Tickets and live requests follow
items.body: Problems become tickets, and requests for a person become live requests your team can pick up.

items.title: Your team works from one view
items.body: Filter, sort and save views of customers, tickets and live requests.

features.title: What you can do with the CRM.
features.intro: The CRM grows with the conversations your agents have.

items.title: Manage three tables
items.body: Customers, tickets and live requests each have their own table, overview and settings.

items.title: Add your own fields
items.body: Create custom fields with a label, type, placeholder and required setting.

items.title: Save views
items.body: Save filtered and sorted views so your team can come back to the same list.

items.title: Keep notes and history
items.body: Open a record to see its details, notes and related activity.

items.title: Filter by source and agent
items.body: See customers by where they came from and which agent they spoke to.

items.title: See duplicates merged
items.body: Customers are de-duplicated automatically, and phone-verified customers show a badge.

items.title: Use HubSpot instead
items.body: If your team already works in HubSpot, the agent can save leads there.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: The CRM saves what customers share in the chat. It does not identify anonymous visitors.
Ticket and lead limits depend on your plan.

items.a: No. Steps AI includes a CRM for customers, tickets and live requests. Connect HubSpot if your team already uses it.

items.q: Can I add my own fields?
items.a: Yes. Add fields such as text, number, email, phone or dropdown, and mark them as required.

items.q: Can I see records for one agent?
items.a: Yes. Each agent has its own CRM view, and the account CRM shows all agents together.

items.label: Unified inbox
items.body: Reply to customers with their record beside the chat.

items.label: HubSpot
items.body: Send leads to HubSpot if your team works there.

items.label: Analytics
items.body: See where leads come from and what they ask.

cta.title: See the CRM with your own business in mind.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through it using your own information and channels.
